# dockercompose Provider

Deploys Docker Compose projects to local or remote (SSH) Docker hosts. Compose runs in-process, so the machine running Terraform needs no `docker`, `docker compose` or `ssh` binary.

Without a connection block, the provider connects like `local {}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Remote Docker host over SSH. The key comes from another resource or remote
# state and stays in memory: no key file, no ssh binary.
provider "dockercompose" {
  ssh {
    host        = hcloud_server.app.ipv4_address
    user        = "deploy"
    private_key = tls_private_key.deploy.private_key_openssh
    host_key    = "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAI..."
  }
}

# Docker daemon on the machine running Terraform (DOCKER_HOST or the default socket).
provider "dockercompose" {
  alias = "local"
  local {}
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `local` (Block, Optional) Connect to a Docker daemon reachable from the machine running Terraform. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--local))
- `ssh` (Block, Optional) Connect to a remote Docker host over SSH. The provider uses its own SSH client: credentials stay in memory and no `ssh` binary is needed.

The Docker socket is reached through SSH stream-local forwarding, so the server must allow it (`AllowTcpForwarding` set to `yes` or `local`, the OpenSSH default). Project files are written over SFTP. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--ssh))

<a id="nestedblock--local"></a>
### Nested Schema for `local`

Optional:

- `host` (String) Docker host URL, for example `unix:///var/run/docker.sock` or `tcp://127.0.0.1:2375`. Defaults to `DOCKER_HOST`, or the platform default when that is unset.


<a id="nestedblock--ssh"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ssh`

Optional:

- `docker_socket` (String) Path of the Docker socket on the remote host. Defaults to `/var/run/docker.sock`.
- `host` (String) Hostname or IP address of the SSH server.
- `host_key` (String) Accepted host keys, one per line, in `authorized_keys` format (`ssh-ed25519 AAAA...`) or `known_hosts` format. Required unless `insecure_ignore_host_key` is set.
- `insecure_ignore_host_key` (Boolean) Accept any host key. This allows man-in-the-middle attacks; use it only for testing.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password authentication, used in addition to or instead of `private_key`.
- `port` (Number) SSH port. Defaults to `22`.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) Private key in OpenSSH or PEM format, for example `tls_private_key.deploy.private_key_openssh`.
- `private_key_passphrase` (String, Sensitive) Passphrase of an encrypted `private_key`.
- `user` (String) SSH user. It needs access to the Docker socket and write access to the project directories.
